parsed.g: Find the product SKUs in the most recent cancelled orders of the customer who has the most cancellations in history
P_t: Navigated to the Sales > Orders page in Magento Admin
Identified that order #000000180 (Jun 13, 2022) is a cancelled order belonging to Samantha Jones
Viewed order #000000180 details and identified products: Karmen Yoga Pant (SKU: WP01-28-Black) and Summit Watch (SKU: 24-MG03)
Opened the Filters panel on the Orders page multiple times
R_t: Successfully apply the 'Canceled' status filter to the orders list to see all cancelled orders
Count cancellations per customer across all cancelled orders to identify the customer with the most cancellations
Confirm whether Samantha Jones is the customer with the most cancellations or identify the correct customer
Find the most recent cancelled order(s) for the customer with the most cancellations
Extract all product SKUs from those most recent cancelled orders
parsed.e_t: The agent is on the Orders / Operations / Sales / Magento Admin page at URL http://172.185.52.29:7780/admin/sales/order/. The page shows the orders list with 308 records found, displayed 200 per page across 2 pages. The Filters panel has just been opened (button [786264] was clicked). The orders table shows unfiltered orders sorted by Purchase Date descending. The first visible order is #000000180 (Jun 13, 2022) for Samantha Jones with status 'Canceled'. The filter panel is now open with Status combobox available for selection.
C: Must identify the customer with the MOST cancellations across all historical orders before determining which orders to examine for SKUs
Must look at the most RECENT cancelled orders (not just any cancelled order) of the top customer
The filter must be applied and confirmed before counting cancellations per customer

F_t.cause: Each time the agent clicked the 'Canceled' option in the Status dropdown, the page navigated away from the Orders page back to the Dashboard instead of applying the filter. The agent repeatedly opened the SALES menu and clicked Orders link, then opened Filters and selected Canceled, but the selection never resulted in a filtered view - the agent kept ending up back at the unfiltered orders list or the dashboard. The DOM evidence shows the combobox expanded with 'Canceled' option selected=False each time, suggesting the click registered on the option but the filter was never applied via the 'Apply Filters' button.

The agent repeatedly clicked the SALES link which opened the dropdown menu but did not navigate to Orders. The agent then had to click the Orders link separately. This caused many wasted steps cycling between Dashboard and Orders page.

F_t.action: Clicked 'Apply Filters' button was never reached after selecting Canceled status
F_t.cause: After selecting 'Canceled' from the Status dropdown, the agent never clicked the 'Apply Filters' button [3330/40723/etc.] to actually apply the filter. The DOM shows the filter panel with Apply Filters button available but it was never clicked in the trajectory up to step 75.

K_t: Order #000000180 (Jun 13, 2022, 11:06:22 PM) is a cancelled order for Samantha Jones (customer ID 16, email: coolcat321@hotmail.com)
Order #000000180 contains: Karmen Yoga Pant SKU: WP01-28-Black and Summit Watch SKU: 24-MG03
The Orders page has 308 total records across 2 pages (200 per page)
The Status filter dropdown contains 'Canceled' as an option and must be selected followed by clicking 'Apply Filters' button to filter
The agent has never successfully applied the Canceled status filter - the filter panel opens but Apply Filters is never clicked
Samantha Jones appears as the first cancelled order visible in the unfiltered list, but it is unknown if she has the most cancellations overall
The orders list is sorted by Purchase Date descending (most recent first)
To find the customer with most cancellations, the agent needs to filter by Canceled status, then count occurrences of each customer name in the filtered results
